desc: Derive and verify the reverse-placement invariant: when processing i descending, all values > i already occupy their final slots, so i goes into the P_i-th empty slot.
Implement a Fenwick tree initialized with all ones (all slots empty), supporting prefix sums and find-by-order (smallest index with prefix sum >= k) via bitmask binary lifting in O(log N).
Main loop: read N and P array; for i from N down to 1, locate slot = kth_empty(P_i), set answer[slot] = i, and update BIT at slot by -1.
Handle 1-indexing carefully and fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read, split) for N up to 5e5.
Write final answer as space-separated values to stdout; sanity-check logic mentally against samples (e.g., P=1 1 2 1 yields 4 2 3 1).
